q2_gaps: concessive / contrastive "while" (= "whereas"): the instruction set lists "while" among the TEMPORAL connectives that take no connective atom and map to During, and never addresses its concessive sense, so the contrast between the two clauses has no licensed carrier here

a cause/concession/contrast connective joining two KIND-LEVEL clauses: the connective-atom form needs two reified eventualities as endpoints, but both clauses here are kind-level property claims (ConditionalProperty / partitive Inheritance) that reify no event witnesses
notes: The partitive is textbook — definite superset, subset with SubsetOf plus ProportionOf most, and the property on the subset by Inheritance rather than Member; "in Canada" correctly goes in the ConditionalProperty condition slot as a bare proper-noun constant, and "related to prostitution" is correctly read as a reduced relative with the prepositional verb's object in the To oblique.
